title: ALLEXCEPT only keeps an existing filter: grouped by another column it gives the grand total
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[Using AllExcept] = CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALLEXCEPT ( 'Product', 'Product'[Category] ) )

source.quote: If there are no filters on Customer[Continent] when ALLEXCEPT is invoked, there will be no filters after ALLEXCEPT has done its job.
source.supports: ALLEXCEPT does not add a filter: with no filter on the kept column, nothing is left after it

derivation: Each row filters Product[Product] only. There is no filter on Product[Category] to keep, so ALLEXCEPT removes the product filter and leaves an empty filter context: 540 on every row, not the category total.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
